summary: The diff implements the get RegExp.prototype.multiline accessor (code unit 0x6D) and a local RegExpHasFlag helper in the one in-scope file. The helper follows the spec: non-Object throws TypeError; a value without [[OriginalFlags]] returns undefined when it is %RegExp.prototype% and otherwise throws TypeError; with a slot, it returns whether the flags contain the code unit. Spec steps are kept as comments above their code. No special-casing, swallowed errors, or made-up values were found. The gate report shows +10 passing with 0 regressions.
